svg.title: Messidor 25 — Pintade
svg.desc: A helmeted guineafowl of an old European farm type stands in left profile. Its very small bare bluish-grey head bears a modest horn-brown casque, a short pointed bill and two muted red wattles. A narrow neck descends into the high shoulders of a deep pear-shaped grey-umber body. Small pale pearl markings follow curved breast feathers and the overlapping feathers of a long folded wing; the short tail points down. Two strong scaled legs end in separate natural toes and small claws. Translucent earthy washes and sparse curved engraving give the plumage its volume.
